Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Ms. Rane,

Thank you for meeting us on 24 November 2024 about your dispute with Farhan Khan. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thiruvananthapuram.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 16,20,000.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thiruvananthapuram
